name: Aaroh Kandhare
summary: Aaroh Kandhare builds rockets, combat robots, AI hardware and a Linux you install with a double click.

projects.summary: A Linux you install with a double click, set up for one person or one kiosk, where ten lines of YAML go in and a bootable machine comes out.
I lead engineering on Moonshot's 51-part AI wearable, which is shipping now, and before it went to the factory I caught the camera sitting 2.25 mm outside its own housing.
projects.details: Y Combinator-backed · engineering team lead · 11 factory drawings · 168 fit checks across 1,275 part pairs

projects.summary: I built a 3D-printed rocket that steers with its own thrust, and wrote the 6-DOF simulator that's put it through 14,030 runs.
projects.details: sponsored by Stanford · thrust vector control · 430 g · flight computer in electronics testing

projects.summary: I'm the first engineer at Cadybara, a Founders Inc-backed text-to-CAD startup, and I built the backend and the public arena where AI-generated designs go head to head.
projects.details: my study there: more prompt detail made the CAD worse, 62.5% at level 7 against 40.1% at level 10

projects.summary: I design air, surface and underwater vehicles and the ocean-atmosphere missions they run for NOAA's lab at the University of Washington, and I speed up metal 3D-printing models at Northwestern.
projects.details: UW and NOAA PMEL · Northwestern · 14.7 TB of model output indexed without downloading it

projects.summary: I've built and fought combat robots at 1, 3, 5 and 25 lb, and now I lead design on a 250 lb one for a planned 2028 BattleBots entry.
projects.details: founder, Mantis · design lead, Bravado · a brushless hub motor I designed for the 1 lb

projects.summary: I placed 2nd in a VEX World Championship division, and I've qualified for Worlds five times in eight seasons since fourth grade.
projects.details: captain and engineering lead · VEX IQ and V5

projects.summary: On FRC 1899 I led 17 students across 3 subteams on a t-shirt cannon, and built mechanisms for our 2024 World Championship robot.
projects.details: Saints Robotics · offseason project lead · mechanical

projects.summary: I built Vaidra's speech pipeline in 7 languages, for classrooms in India that have one speaker and no screens.
Moss wrecks roofs here and the companies scraping it off by hand make too much money to automate it, so we're doing it with drones and an autopilot I wrote.
projects.details: backed by Founders Inc · the autopilot plans coverage across a roof and corrects for wind

projects.summary: I co-founded CoachT, AI coaching software for taekwondo studios, and it was acquired when I was 16.
projects.details: chief marketing officer · 50+ studio accounts · automated all of our outreach
